text:
mara (PM): Quick capture before tomorrow's board: we need final GA bullets for SLA, docs gate, rollback rules, monitoring minima, pricing posture, and any hard legal nits.
dev (Eng): Perf reality: we can commit p50~120ms and p95~380ms for standard routes if we freeze batching defaults and enable KV cache. Long context/prompt-heavy routes will be declared out-of-scope in GA.
syl (SRE): SLA measurement: measure availability as successful responses (2xx/3xx) over total calls, exclude scheduled maint windows. Propose monthly objective 99.9%. Outage definition = sustained 5xx >0.5% for 10m OR streaming timeouts >20s.
joni (SRE): small note: need an error-budget example in SLA that legal can sign off on. I'll post a calc shortly.
toni (Docs): Docs gate: public Quickstart + 2-page Troubleshooting FAQ + short SLA explainer required at GA. Internal runbook (incidents + escalation matrix) must land within 10 business days post-GA. Public FAQ should include token-cost worked examples. ETA drafts tonight.
jules (Legal): Legal flags: remedies = billing credits capped at affected-month invoice; require 30 days' notice for breaking API changes; include force majeure. Need exact sentence for "service unavailability" to approve. Also prefer credit-only remedy (no penalties).
fin-bot: billing: shadow-run scheduled during canary for 72h once canary hits 10% traffic. Committed pricing must wait until E2E billing tests pass (2 business days).
mara (PM): Proposed final bullets to lock: SLA objective 99.9% monthly; p95 target guideline 400ms (non-contractual until post-canary); remedies = billing credits capped; Docs: Quickstart + FAQ + SLA explainer required; internal runbook within 10 days; Rollback: auto-rollback if error-rate >0.5% for 5m or p95 >2x baseline for 5m; Monitoring: p50/p95 per-route, per-model token-cost, per-route error-rate, cache-hit; Alerts: p95 spike, error-rate >0.5% 10m, cache-hit drop >20%. Pricing: public "indicative" self-serve, committed by contract only.
dev (Eng): +1 assuming we freeze SDK/contract surface for GA (mark as v1). We'll open PR for batching defaults and the SDK freeze tag.
syl (SRE): +1 pending I post the exact credits formula + error-budget calc for legal to review in 2h. Also request 90d traces and 365d incident metadata retention.
toni (Docs): +1. Drafts inbound tonight with token-cost examples (e.g., "100 tokens * $0.0008 = $0.08").
jules (Legal): +1 pending exact outage sentence and the error-budget example. I'll post wording shortly.
mara (PM): Great 1 I'll compile into the GA one-pager and lock decisions unless any blocker appears. If canary alarms or billing shadow shows issues, pause rollout and call an emergency sync here. :rocket:
